name: Sanford Limited
summary: Sanford Limited engages in farming, harvesting, processing, storage, and marketing of seafood products in North America, Europe, China, Australia, New Zealand, and internationally. It operates through Wildcatch and Aquaculture segments. The company catches and processes inshore and deepwater fish species, as well as farms, harvests, and processes mussels and salmon. It provides antarctic toothfish, arrow squid, black oreo dory, gemfish, ghost shark, giant stargazer, greenshell mussels, hake, hoki, king salmon, ling, pale ghost shark, red cod, rough skate, sea perch, silver and white warehou, orange roughy, scampi, smooth oreo dory, and southern blue whiting.
